stem: The paid media lead wants to switch on user-provided data collection for enhanced conversions, and asks whether the site can then stop sending its user ID for signed-in customers. What is the accurate answer?

options.text: Yes: user-provided data collection only starts once the user ID has been switched off
No: the user ID has to stay, because user-provided data works only in the Health category
Yes: enhanced conversions read the CRM directly, so neither of the two is needed any more
No: Google recommends sending the two together, not one of them in place of the other
